exposure: parents-in-law's preference to baby boy while devaluing baby girl
cohort: 522 pregnant women in China who responded to PPD screening during their 2nd to 4th postpartum months
finding: Parents-in-law's preference for baby boy while devaluing baby girl, dissatisfaction with husband's support, cesarean delivery, and mixed feeding were strongly associated with significant PPD symptoms.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was strongly associated with significant PPD symptoms.
